mission.item2Desc: Pony deploys the bikes and scooters in its active cities. We handle the maintenance, charging and repairs. You do nothing.

whyInvest.item1Desc: Up to 8.5% interest rate. Driven by the high structural profitability of shared bikes and scooters managed by pony
whyInvest.item2Desc: The investment is backed by physical bikes and scooters, engineered by pony for durability and resilience. Physical assets with their own worth.
whyInvest.item3Desc: A pony ride produces up to 10× less CO₂ than a car, meaning your investment directly helps cut emissions.
whyInvest.item4Desc: Pony is the only French player in the sector and a leading operator, with 22 cities in service. Our bikes are designed internally by our own engineering team and produced in France by the Manufacture Française du Cycle.
whyInvest.item5Desc: At the time of your investment, we allocate specific ponies to you, they become virtually yours. Receive notifications on rides and maintenance activity, and access their live GPS location anytime!

limitedRisks.item1Title: Pony bears the risk of low demand
limitedRisks.item1Desc: Even if demand and therefore revenue falls below expectations, pony will make the monthly payments as planned.
limitedRisks.item2Title: Pony bears the risk of vandalism
limitedRisks.item2Desc: Theft and vandalism remain limited. Regardless, any losses are fully absorbed by pony and never passed on to investors. These risks are accounted for in the business model.
limitedRisks.item3Desc: We operate under multi-year permits across all our cities, working hand in hand with local authorities as a trusted mobility partner. Over 95% of our permits are renewed. If not, pony redeploys the fleet to other cities.
limitedRisks.item4Desc: Pony Invest is an investment platform regulated by the AMF and operated by Pony SAS. Investments are structured as bonds issued to the public in accordance with the French Code monétaire et financier. A summary information document (DIS) has been filed with the AMF.

howWeOperate.title: Pony takes care of everything.
howWeOperate.item1Desc: The pony mechanic team makes sure the bikes and scooters are safe, sound, clean for users to rides. We use proven maintenance & quality control techniques in order to ensure maximum service level everyday.
howWeOperate.item2Desc: Our logistics team ensures batteries are charged and vehicles are available where and when users need them most. They operate using electric vans and cargo bikes to minimise environmental impact.
howWeOperate.item3Desc: Our bikes are designed internally by our own engineering team and produced in France by the Manufacture Française du Cycle.
howWeOperate.item4Desc: We are working hand in hand with local authorities as a trusted mobility partner. Over 95% of our permits are renewed.

about.title: Description
about.paragraph2Intro: Pony is the French leader in shared micro-mobility. We design, deploy and operate electric bikes and scooters across France, already present in 22 cities with over 500,000 regular users and more than 20,000 rides per day.
about.paragraph2Opportunity: This campaign gives you the opportunity to invest directly in our fleet: the bikes and scooters you finance will be deployed on the streets of French cities, and their operation is what generates the return on your investment.
about.paragraph2GrowthTitle: Micro-mobility is experiencing sustained growth in France:
about.paragraph2GrowthItem1: - Increasing urban density and traffic congestion make cars less and less viable for short trips
about.paragraph2GrowthItem2: - The growing share of transportation in French household spending pushes people to seek cheaper and more efficient alternatives
about.paragraph2GrowthItem3: - The weight of cars in CO2 emissions pushes users and public authorities towards more sustainable alternatives
about.paragraph2Ambition: Pony is growing accordingly: our activity nearly doubled between 2024 and 2025, and we regularly win new tenders to deploy in new cities. Our ambition: to become the reference player in shared mobility in France.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: We open investment campaigns at the pace of our expansion needs: winning a new tender, launching a new city, or densifying the fleet in an existing city.
howItWorks.step1: 1. Once funds are raised, pony orders the vehicles
howItWorks.step2: 2. Bikes and scooters are delivered and put into service within approximately 12 months
howItWorks.step3: 3. Once in operation, the margin generated by their use finances the repayment of your investment
howItWorks.outro: Concretely, for the first 12 months, interest is compounded and added to your capital. From month 13 to month 48, you receive a fixed monthly payment combining capital and interest, directly to your bank account.

capitalProtection.title: Capital protection
capitalProtection.intro1: Pony takes on the commercial performance risk and the customer risk.
capitalProtection.intro2: Our model rests on two solid pillars: the tangible value of our assets (a fleet of real vehicles) and our operating licenses with cities, signed for long durations (between 4 and 10 years) and renewed in the vast majority of cases (75% of cases).
capitalProtection.guarantees: Pony takes on the main operational risks and pays the scheduled monthly installments even in the event of:
capitalProtection.guarantee2: - Vandalism and damage to the fleet → pony replaces the vehicles
capitalProtection.guarantee3: - Non-renewal of an operating license → fleets are redeployed to a new city

faq.title: FAQs
faq.q2: Why invest and adopt a pony?
faq.q6: When and how will I receive interest and capital repayment?
faq.q7: I'm already a Pony Angel — can I pay with my Angel balance?
faq.q8: Can I privatise one of my virtual ponies?
faq.a1:
Adopt a Pony is a programme that lets you invest in a fleet of Pony electric bikes and scooters.

The principle is win-win: Pony funds the fleets it needs to grow, and you earn an attractive monthly return while supporting the development of more sustainable mobility in the cities where Pony operates.
faq.a2: • High returns: up to 8.5% annual return, the equivalent of 25% in gains over the full period, thanks to the strong structural profitability of the bikes and scooters operated by Pony. • A tangible asset: your investment is backed by real bikes and scooters, designed by Pony to be durable and robust. An underlying asset with its own intrinsic value. • 10x fewer emissions: a Pony trip emits up to 10x less CO2 than a car. You directly help cut CO2 emissions in the cities where Pony operates. • A French leader: Pony is the only French player in the sector and the leader, with 22 cities in service. Our bikes are designed in-house by our engineers and made in France by the Manufacture Française du Cycle. • Real-time tracking: when you invest, we allocate ponies that virtually become yours. Get notifications about trips and maintenance, and see their live GPS location!
faq.a3: Our model rests on four fundamentals that let us generate an attractive operating margin: • Unique expertise: Pony has been operating for 7 years and has built world-leading know-how in managing shared fleets, driven by highly experienced teams and in-house tools refined over the years. • Robust assets: our vehicles last more than 7 years. Designed entirely in-house, they rarely break down and we keep full control over their repairability, handled on an express basis. • Strong and growing demand: usage of our services grows every year. We now have more than 500,000 active users, and this demand is growing faster than the size of our fleet. • The best batteries on the market: their range is nearly 1.6x greater than our competitors'. The result: a very low charging cost, and therefore higher profitability per vehicle.
faq.a4:
Unlike traditional crowdfunding platforms, Adopt a Pony directly bears the operational and commercial risk of the financed project. Concretely:

• If demand is lower than forecast, we still pay your monthly returns.

• If the fleet is damaged, we replace it without interrupting interest payments.

• If a city licence isn't renewed, we redeploy the vehicles to another city and keep paying you.

In short, we absorb most of the operational and commercial uncertainties of the financed project. The residual risk is limited to a Pony default scenario: in that case, repayment would rely on reselling the assets. See here for all identified risks.
faq.a5: Interest rates on Adopt a Pony are shown gross (before tax). Individuals: • French tax residents: interest is subject to a 30% flat tax (PFU), withheld at source and pre-filled in your tax return. If you fall under the progressive income tax scale, send us a declaration on your honour and we'll pay the gross interest. • Non-French tax residents: no withholding at source. Declare according to your local rules. Companies: • Interest is treated as income and subject to corporate or income tax, depending on your legal status. Every January, Adopt a Pony provides you with a tax statement to help you complete your return. For personalised advice, consult a tax professional.
faq.a6:
Interest and capital are paid monthly from the 13th month through to the 48th month.

Why the delay? In practice, up to 12 months can pass between ordering and deploying the fleets you've financed. This period includes, for example, purchasing and sourcing raw materials, production and transport.

To align the financing mechanism as closely as possible with the reality of the business model, a grace period may be introduced. During this grace period, your interest is capitalised and added to your capital, which is then repaid each month along with the associated interest.
faq.a7: We aim to make this option available from the next campaign for all Pony Angels who hold a balance, and we're actively working on it. We'll keep you posted as soon as the feature is available.
faq.a8: The big new feature of Adopt is that you no longer invest in a single vehicle, but in an entire fleet of bikes or scooters. Privatising a single vehicle is therefore replaced by a set of perks — free rides, tracking your fleet in the app — and many more features to come.
